strings.banner.title: PROGRESSION QOL
strings.banner.credit: DRAGONSWORD REWARD CONFIGURATOR  •  CREATED BY NECTARINES
strings.banner.build: VERSION 0.9.5  •  BUILT FOR GAME 1.0.10  •  ONE CUSTOM PAK  •  OFFLINE
strings.status.ready: Ready — builds are local, offline, and reversible.
strings.section.world.title: WORLD
strings.section.world.description: Exploration rewards. x1 is vanilla; x5 gives five times the amount.
strings.section.activities.title: ACTIVITIES
strings.section.activities.description: Dungeons, hunts, raids, and Sudden Missions. Gold and Crafting Materials include the two underwater dungeons.
strings.section.lootShape.title: LOOT SHAPE
strings.section.lootShape.description: Changes equipment rolls; neither option adds rewards by itself.
strings.reward.gathering.title: World gathering
strings.reward.enemy.title: Enemy materials
strings.reward.enemy.description: Material drops from ordinary and field enemies.
strings.reward.chests.title: Safe chest stacks
strings.reward.chests.description: Stackable loot from one-time world exploration chests. Dungeon chests, unique items, and progression items stay unchanged.
strings.reward.equipment.title: Equipment
strings.reward.equipment.description: Activity gear. x10 max. Inventory: 500 items.
strings.reward.materials.title: Crafting materials
strings.reward.materials.description: Trait stones, boss parts, Raid runes, upgrades, and underwater loot.
strings.reward.emblems.title: Emblems
strings.reward.emblems.description: Exchange Shop currency; Sudden Missions included.
strings.reward.gold.title: Gold
strings.reward.experience.title: Experience
strings.reward.currencyXp.title: Currency EXP items
strings.reward.currencyXp.description: Character, Equipment, and Karma EXP items from Currency Dungeons only.
strings.loot.spread.title: Spread equipment rolls
strings.loot.spread.description: Off (vanilla): multiplied gear stays stacked. On: the same total is split into independent equipment selections for more variety. Equipment only; Raid runes and item stats are unchanged.
strings.loot.rarity.title: Favor better rarity
strings.loot.rarity.description: Off (vanilla): original rarity odds. On: supported mixed-tier equipment and Raid rune pools favor their better listed tier. Quantity and item stats are unchanged.
strings.loot.chance.title: Better-tier chance
strings.loot.chance.description: When enabled, about 9 of 10 supported rolls select the better tier.
strings.build.header.title: BUILD & INSTALL
strings.build.header.description: Choose settings, then use Build + Install. The verified PAK replaces only this app's previous PAK after confirmation; other mods are never changed.
strings.build.gamePath.title: DragonSword installation
strings.build.gamePath.description: Select the game folder—or DS, Paks, ~mods, Win64, or the game EXE. It is normalized automatically; installation goes to DS\Content\Paks\~mods.
strings.build.outputPath.title: Build output folder
strings.build.outputPath.description: Defaults to this Windows user's Documents folder. Verified PAKs and reports are created here; any writable folder can be selected.
strings.scan.title: Installed mod check
strings.scan.description: Scans mod PAKs in DS\Content\Paks and ~mods, then verifies their internal table paths. It never disables, deletes, or moves another mod.
strings.scan.gameNotFound: DragonSword installation not found from the selected path.
strings.scan.buildUnknown: Steam build could not be verified. Installation is available with a compatibility warning.
strings.scan.newerBuild: Newer game build {detected} detected. Validated build: {required}. Installation is available with a compatibility warning.
strings.scan.olderBuild: Older game build {detected} detected. Update the game before installation.
strings.scan.clear: No known reward or material conflicts found.
strings.scan.conflicts: {count} possible reward/material conflict(s) found. Review the Audit Log.
strings.language.header.title: INTERFACE LANGUAGE
strings.language.header.description: Choose the language used by the configurator. Language files are plain UTF-8 JSON and can be edited or shared without recompiling the application.
strings.language.current.title: Language for next launch
strings.language.current.description: English is the fallback for missing text. Initial translations are community-editable and may be improved over time.
strings.language.savedMessage: {language} will be used the next time Progression QOL starts. Close and reopen the application to apply it.
strings.language.folderErrorTitle: Language folder could not be opened
strings.language.fileNote: To improve a translation, edit its JSON file in the Languages folder using a UTF-8 text editor. Keep the keys unchanged; only edit values inside strings.

strings.profile.deletePrompt:
Delete the saved profile ‘{name}’?

This deletes only its JSON settings file. It does not change any PAK.
strings.profile.name: Profile name
strings.profile.importDescription: Select an older Progression QOL application folder or its Profiles folder
strings.profile.error.open: Profiles folder could not be opened
strings.browse.gameDescription: Select DragonSword Awakening, DS, Paks, ~mods, or Win64
strings.browse.outputDescription: Select where verified builds will be created
strings.build.status.failed: Build failed safely; no game files were changed.
strings.install.prompt:
The new PAK is built and verified, but it is not installed yet.

Install it now? The existing Progression QOL PAK will be disabled and backed up.
strings.install.newerBuildWarning: Newer DragonSword build {detected} detected. This configurator was validated on build {required}. You can continue, but it may be out of date and rewards may not work as intended. Restore vanilla if anything looks wrong and watch the mod page for an update.
strings.install.unknownBuildWarning: The Steam build could not be verified. You can continue, but this configurator may be out of date and rewards may not work as intended. Restore vanilla if anything looks wrong and watch the mod page for an update.
strings.install.olderBuildBlocked: DragonSword build {detected} is older than this configurator's validated build {required}. Update the game before installing.
strings.install.status.success: Installed and hash-verified. Resolve any logged conflicts before launch.
strings.vanilla.status.noPak: Vanilla defaults selected — no Progression QOL PAK is installed.
strings.vanilla.noPakMessage:
All settings are already at vanilla defaults, and no Progression QOL PAK is installed.

Nothing needs to be removed.
strings.vanilla.restorePrompt:
Every reward setting is at its vanilla default.

Disable the installed Progression QOL PAK and return this mod's rewards to vanilla behavior?

The PAK will be preserved as a disabled backup. Other mods will not be changed.
strings.vanilla.status.cancelled: Vanilla restore cancelled — the installed PAK was not changed.
strings.vanilla.status.restored: Progression QOL disabled — vanilla rewards restored for this mod.
strings.vanilla.restoredMessage:
Progression QOL has been disabled and its PAK was preserved as a non-loadable backup.

This restores vanilla reward behavior for this mod. Any other installed reward mod may still affect the game.
